books.title: Refractive Systems: Designing Spatial & Liquid Glass Interfaces
books.subtitle: Optical hierarchy, translucent surfaces, and tactile motion for modern digital products
books.author: Aarav Mehta
books.author_bio: Aarav Mehta is a principal design systems architect focused on high-clarity digital reading and spatial interface tokens.
books.short_description: A practical guide to crafting translucent, optically grounded user interfaces with clean typography and accessible contrast.
books.full_description:
Refractive Systems explores the structure and perception of modern translucent interfaces. Moving past decorative blur, this volume establishes a clear framework for optical depth, luminance contrast, subtle edge highlights, and responsive surface adaptation.

Across eleven illustrated chapters, you will learn how to construct multi-layered hierarchies that remain legible on mobile and desktop alike, while respecting hardware budgets and reduced-motion accessibility.

sample_pages.content:
Every translucent surface in a digital interface communicates spatial order. When a surface subtly refracts the warm canvas beneath it, the reader infers hierarchy and focus without heavy borders.

In this chapter we break every surface into three measurable tokens: backdrop attenuation, surface tint luminance, and the 1-pixel specular rim.
Readable typography requires disciplined contrast. Pairing deep charcoal ink (#292929) with warm cream (#F7F3EB) and crisp white surfaces (#FFFFFF) ensures effortless long-form reading.

highlights: Complete CSS token reference for translucent surfaces, borders, and elevation
Contrast checklists for desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports
Reduced-motion fallbacks and performance guidelines
Includes DRM-free vector PDF and reflowable EPUB3 files

books.author: Dr. Vikramaditya Rao
books.author_bio: Dr. Vikramaditya Rao has spent 18 years architecting payment clearing switches and distributed storage engines.
books.short_description: Master the engineering principles behind payment-grade state machines, idempotent webhook ingestion, and deterministic recovery.
books.full_description: Modern financial and commerce infrastructure cannot tolerate ambiguous state. Deterministic Scale walks through state machines, write-ahead logs, serializable isolation patterns, and cryptographic verification pipelines used in reliable transaction systems.

sample_pages.chapter_title: Why At-Least-Once Delivery Requires Idempotent Sinks
sample_pages.content: Every external webhook is a potentially duplicated message. An idempotent sink records the provider's unique event identifier inside the same atomic boundary that transitions the order state.

highlights: State-machine diagrams for orders, captures, and refunds
PostgreSQL row-level locking and idempotency key schemas
Complete reference implementations in TypeScript and SQL

legal_pages.title: Terms of Service
legal_pages.subtitle: Governing your use of the ENOX Ebooks digital marketplace and creator tools
legal_pages.content_markdown:
## 1. Agreement to Terms
By accessing or using **ENOX Ebooks**, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. Replace placeholder legal entity details in Admin Settings prior to commercial launch.

## 2. Digital Products & Personal License
Upon verified payment in Indian Rupees (INR), customers receive a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to download and use the purchased digital product for personal or permitted professional reference.

## 3. Creator Plans & Commissions
Creators may publish under the **Free Creator Plan** (₹0/month, up to 5 active listings, 30% platform commission per sale) or the **ENOX Premium Plan** (₹999/month, up to 25 active listings, 20% platform commission per sale). If a Premium subscription expires, listings above the 5-product Free limit are temporarily unlisted—never deleted—and existing customer purchases remain accessible in customer libraries.

legal_pages.title: Privacy Policy
legal_pages.subtitle: How ENOX Ebooks collects, protects, and processes personal information
legal_pages.content_markdown:
## 1. Data Minimization
ENOX Ebooks collects only the information necessary to manage accounts, verify orders, deliver digital files, and calculate creator earnings.

## 2. Payment Security
ENOX never stores raw card numbers, CVV codes, or UPI PINs. Payment processing is handled via server-verified gateway integration.

legal_pages.title: Refund Policy
legal_pages.subtitle: Clear rules for digital product orders, defective files, and duplicate charges
legal_pages.content_markdown:
## 1. Eligible Refund Scenarios
We issue full refunds when a digital file is technically defective and cannot be replaced within 48 hours, when a duplicate charge occurs, or when an undownloaded order is cancelled within 24 hours of purchase.

## 2. Ownership Revocation on Refund
When a refund is processed, order status transitions to `refunded` and library download access for that order is automatically revoked.

legal_pages.title: Digital Download Policy
legal_pages.subtitle: How secure delivery and short-lived signed URLs work on ENOX Ebooks
legal_pages.content_markdown:
## 1. Verified Entitlement
Download buttons are active only when the server confirms an active, non-refunded purchase record in your ENOX Library.

## 2. Short-Lived Signed Links
Every download request generates a short-lived (5-minute) cryptographically signed token from private storage.

legal_pages.title: Seller Guidelines
legal_pages.subtitle: Quality, originality, and approval standards for ENOX creators
legal_pages.content_markdown:
## 1. Originality & Intellectual Property
Creators must own full rights or valid commercial licenses for all ebooks, templates, study guides, and digital files submitted to ENOX Ebooks.

## 2. Editorial Review Workflow
New product submissions enter the `pending_review` state. Products only appear in the public marketplace after an ENOX moderator approves them to `published`.

## 3. Accurate Descriptions
Listings must clearly state file formats (PDF, EPUB), page counts, and what the buyer will receive without misleading guarantees or fabricated ratings.

legal_pages.title: Copyright Complaints
legal_pages.subtitle: Procedure for reporting intellectual property or copyright infringement
legal_pages.content_markdown:
## 1. Reporting Infringement
If you believe a listing on ENOX Ebooks infringes your copyright, click the **Report Product** button on the product detail page or contact our moderation desk via the Contact page with:
- Identification of the copyrighted work claimed to have been infringed.
- The URL or product title of the reported ENOX listing.
- Your contact details and a good-faith statement of ownership.

## 2. Takedown & Investigation
Reported listings are reviewed in the Admin Copyright Reports queue and may be unlisted or removed pending investigation.
